notes.md: - **National Clean Energy Fund (NCEF):** announced in the **2010-11 Budget**; financed by the **Clean Energy Cess** on **coal, lignite and peat** (Rs 50 per tonne from 1 July 2010, raised to **Rs 400** by 2016-17); used to fund **research and innovative projects in clean energy**. The cess ended with **GST (1 July 2017)**.

- **State-wise potential (NIWE):** at **120 m**, **Gujarat** is highest (**142.56 GW**), then Rajasthan (127.75), Karnataka (124.15), Maharashtra (98.21), **AP (74.90 GW)**. At **150 m**, **Rajasthan** is highest (284.25 GW), then Gujarat (180.79 GW).
